protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers, one record per visited class
protocol.abort: K_STALL=32 consecutive squarings, armed by a guard admission
protocol.meter: one global counter in instructions; every step, key build, probe, record write, replay and verification asks fits() before acting; a replay or verification that does not fit abandons that worker

claim.rule: minimal n with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W, exact integer check; n-1 asserted to fail

row_derivations.walk_steps: steps x STEP; STEP = f_mul x 22409 + (1-f_mul) x 25372
row_derivations.record_writes_and_insert: steps x 934 Ir (688 B serialize + dict_insert 246)
row_derivations.trap_waste_bound: route measured_windows: ring-6 census over slot families of length <=6 (0 expected trapped windows) against measured 7680000 protocol steps (0 admissions); charged at 32 steps + normal-run (1-f_mul)^32 x 32
row_derivations.index_slots_widened_refs: steps x 9 Ir: one touched slot per visited record, 1 Ir per word; slots = ceil(S/0.625) = 153285869553487776880359083998396376144, slot ref 127 bits = 2 words, layout 9 words = key48(6) + ref(2) + tag(1)

charges.price_basis: otool static span of the shipped symbols; the two priced kernels are loop-free in the listing (no backward branch inside the span), so each instruction executes at most once per call and the span is an upper bound on the executed count

addressing.single_formula: bytes = records x 688 (pool) + ceil(records/0.625) x (6 + ceil(ceil(log2 slots)/64) + 1) x 8 (index)
addressing.v26_flaw: v26 charged 8 Ir per record for one slot each and counted the index as 65536*7*8 bytes in the ledger while the prose said S*64 B; both are replaced by this one layout

dictionary.structure: open addressing, four probes, stride 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15, seven-word entries (six key words + tag), eviction of the smallest leading key word when all four probes are occupied

family_census.premise: H4: kappa labels uniform on Z/12 and independent of the slot; the vanishing sums are exact in Z[zeta] mod Phi_12

trap.period6_note: a period-6 family (abcdefabcdef) has a length-6 window with six distinct slots, which every ring depth >= 1 admits; ring 6 does not exclude it.  The charge therefore comes from this census and the measured traffic, not from an exclusion claim.

survival.note: ONE fixture scale measured (rp=521041, 400 pairs).  v27 claims exactly that; v26's manifest claimed two.

success.procedure: draw Beta(k+1,n-k+1) for each census, Beta(ret+1,pairs-ret+1) for retention, U[1,band] for the residual divisor; multiply; 5th percentile is the bound
success.v26_flaw: v26 multiplied a CP endpoint by a point retention and divided by the band: a product of quantiles, not a quantile of the product

tie_analysis.resolution: kappa = ks.index(min(ks)) is the FIRST minimum (deterministic); the pool slot is derived from sorted(ks), invariant to which rotation attains the minimum, so a tie cannot fork the table index or the record key.
